LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.RunsOnSaveLoad: The pawn clean up runs when game save is loaded
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.GentleCleanUpCheckbox: More "gentle" pawn cleanup (read the tooltip for details)
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.GentleCleanUpTooltip: You may need to turn this option if you use RIMMSqol, or some other mods. The reason: some mods may create non-standard map objects that store pawns. If the mod in question fails to mark the pawn as forever-kept, pawn may be removed by the garbage collection. This option TRIES to address the issue
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.RunMothballerCheckbox: Forcibly run pawns mothballer on save load?
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.DiscardAnimalsAfter: Discard eligible animals (regardless of faction) after {0} days (60 days = 1 year)
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.DiscardColonistsAfter: Discard eligible colonist pawns after {0} days (60 days = 1 year)
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.RunOtherPawnsCleanUpCheck: Run a cleanup for all the other pawns?
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.DiscardOtherPawnsAfter: Discard eligible pawns after {0} days (60 days = 1 year)
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.DiscardTooltip: You can set it to 0 and discard world pawns immediately, but it's not advised
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.RunQuestsCleanUpCheckbox: Run a cleanup for old quest records?
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.DiscardQuestsAfter: Discard old quests after {0} days (60 days = 1 year)
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.DiscardQuestsAfterTooltip: Won't improve your performance much, but may reduce save file size
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.RunBadBulletsCleanupCheck: Remove thrown Throwing Axe? (to fix a possible VFE-Medieval 2 and CE compatibility issue)
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.DetailedReportLetter: Provide detailed report about discarded pawns? It may generate HUGE letters.
LanguageData.MBADP.Settings.AlivePawnsReportLetter: Provide report about the pawns not eligible for cleanup? Useful for debugging
